literal_meaning: চেপে ফেলে যাওয়া বা মুখ বন্ধ হয়ে যাওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: To remain silent without saying anything
example_sentences_in_bangla: কথা না বলে চেপে যাওয়াই ভালো হবে এখন।
example_sentences_in_english: He clammed up in the middle of the argument.
It's better to keep mum and not say anything now.
note: This idiom is widely used in spoken Bengali to advise discretion.
